title: National Emergency Life Support Guidelines & Red Flag Clinical Triage
source_organization: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Govt of India

review_status: Approved by Emergency Medical Relief (EMR) Division

content: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India, National Emergency Life Support protocols establish strict triage criteria for acute life-threatening emergencies. 'Red Flag' category-1 triage conditions mandate immediate resuscitation and zero-delay physician assessment: 1. Airway/Breathing: Severe stridor, cyanosis, SpO2 < 90%, respiratory rate < 8 or > 35/min. 2. Circulation: Hypotension (SBP < 90 mmHg), severe active hemorrhage, capillary refill > 3 seconds, acute crushing chest pain with diaphoresis. 3. Disability: Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) < 9, sudden onset hemiplegia, active convulsing status epilepticus. Emergency access numbers in India: Dial 112 for the unified National Emergency Response Support System, or 108 / 102 for government ambulance emergency medical services.
